about.title: About Mirchumal Panjumal, makers of Rose embroidery thread
about.description: Mirchumal Panjumal makes Rose, RS and Jai Plus embroidery thread in Rajasthan and supplies businesses across India in bulk.
about.who: {legalName} makes embroidery thread and sells it in bulk to businesses across India, under the brands Rose, RS and Jai Plus. We are a manufacturer and supplier, not a retail shop.

process.title: White yarn
process.text: We start with raw white yarn.

process.title: Winding
process.text: The yarn is wound onto smaller packages for the next machines.

process.title: Twisting
process.text: Strands are twisted together to make the thread strong.

process.title: Dyeing
process.text: The white thread is dyed to the shade number.

process.title: Drying
process.text: Dyed thread is dried before it can be wound again.

process.title: Final winding and packing
process.text: Thread is wound onto cones, spools or tubes and packed.
